title: DesignSystem — tokens、type、grid、components、asset contracts
description: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-08 for the object-model row design-system, which now names schemas/interop-dtcg-document.schema.json -- the contract the product actually enforces. Nothing in src/, packages/ or apps/ ever loaded this file: design_layer.write_tokens validates a submitted DTCG token document through interop/dtcg.py, and this shape cannot describe it, because `tokens` here allows only string values while a DTCG group holds {$type,$value,$description} objects. The three remaining sections (typography, grid, components) plus assetContracts are written by no code path at all, so leaving this file bound would have kept a declared contract that no producer or validator implements -- a false offer rather than a capability. Kept in the repository, unchanged, as the shape that was declared before the ruling; no object row may point at it again without first giving the product a reader and a writer for it.
